status: CANDIDATE (GO-H1D; closed by the owner ruling of 2026-10-08, see eligibility-rubric h1d_closure). Forward-only. target-validity-rubric.json (schema /1) is unchanged and remains the record of V1-V4 and S1.
unchanged_from_v1: fields, source_loading, side_rule, checks V1-V4 and S1, declared_not_checked, validator_evidence
rule_source: eligibility-rubric.json sections h1d_validity_states, h1d_control_dependence, h1d_namespace_closure, h1d_freeform. This file restates the state set and reasons; those sections decide dependency.

states.V_VALID: V1-V3 pass, V4 is not unresolved, S1 passes, and at least one changed predicate on W is DATA_DEPENDENT on W (C1), or an option-semantic change to W is eligible under C4.
states.V_INVALID: A mechanical check fails (V1-V3), or the derived target has no DATA_DEPENDENT changed predicate on W and no option-semantic change under C4. The first applicable reason below is recorded; the others may also be recorded.
states.V_AMBIGUOUS: No check fails, but a dependency path or a check is unresolved (listed below). V_AMBIGUOUS is not V and is not INVALID.

invalid_reasons_in_precedence_order.when: The target is validated against a side other than the side rule in v1 requires. Mechanical.
V2 fails: option_prefix ends in a declaration. Mechanical.
V3 fails: a watch segment is not declared on that side. Mechanical.
The watch path names a key matched only by freeformType and not declared as an option (eligibility-rubric h1d_freeform F2). Mechanical.

Every changed predicate touching the target reads only foreign operands and none is gated by W (h1c_mixed_predicate M2). Mechanical once the operand declarations are pinned. Inert under derivation_scope: a derived target has a W path, so this reason is not reached; retained for the record.

The derived target has changed predicates, and each is CONTROL_DEPENDENT_ONLY on W, and none is DATA_DEPENDENT on W; and there is no option-semantic change under C4. Applies only to a target derived under derivation_scope (eligibility-rubric h1d_validity_states.derivation_precondition). Owner ruling 2026-10-08.

ambiguous_states: CALLEE_UNKNOWN on the only dependency path
precedence: 1. Mechanical failure of V1-V3 gives V_INVALID with the first matching reason from the mechanical rows above.

2. A V4 unresolved container, or any ambiguous_states entry on the only dependency path, gives V_AMBIGUOUS. This is checked before reason-based INVALID for dependency reasons, so an open receiver is never reported as invalid.

3. A DATA_DEPENDENT changed predicate on W gives V_VALID when V1-V3 and S1 pass, even if other changed predicates on the same target are CONTROL_DEPENDENT_ONLY or foreign-only. Those are recorded and do not change the state.
4. Otherwise, with the target derived under derivation_scope and no ambiguous entry, the dependency reasons above give V_INVALID.

aggregation.per_target: V_VALID iff precedence 3 holds. V_INVALID iff a reason applies. V_AMBIGUOUS otherwise.
aggregation.per_pr: unchanged from v1: V(PR) iff at least one target is V_VALID and the other targets are V_VALID or explicitly out of scope with a reason. PARTIAL_V is reported separately.
aggregation.hunk_category: V_INVALID carries no E category. V_AMBIGUOUS hunks take E_AMBIGUOUS. V_VALID hunks take the category from the eligibility rubric.

side_for_predicate_hunks: For a hunk whose changed term is a predicate or a helper body, V1-V3 run against the side and module where W is declared. For option-semantic changes, side_rule governs (owner-independent GO-H1D closure clarification).
not_decided_here: Whether the predicate is eligible (eligibility-rubric P_GATING, P_CONTROL, P_SELECTION roles)
